description: Moonfall-original, WoW Forever-inspired secondary combat stats. Provisional balancing; independent reference model until engine integration.
rules: No classes, specializations, upgrade cards or forced builds
All ratings are optional and additive from gear and talent effects
Rating conversion coefficients are Moonfall prototypes, not WoW Forever's combat math
Armor and resistances use capped values; dodge, block and parry are combat actions, not character ratings
Primary base stats, equipment bonuses and talent points remain separate
No changes to original Z or Nyra artwork or saves
